name: Line endings
description: Requires every line terminator in a file to be the configured lf (\n) or crlf (\r\n).
definition: Requires, as a `[warning]`, every line terminator in a file to match `line_endings_mode` (`lf` for `\n`, `crlf` for `\r\n`). Mixed endings and the opposite terminator are both flagged, at the first offending line. A file with no terminators is left to `final-newline`. Automatically fixable: the fix rewrites every terminator to the configured mode and does not invent a missing final newline.
